scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w evals && npm run build -w web --if-present && npm run build -w extension --if-present
scripts.test:rules: npx -y -p node@22 -p firebase-tools firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-secondlook "npm run test:rules -w web"
scripts.emulators: npx -y -p node@22 -p firebase-tools firebase emulators:start --only firestore,auth --project demo-secondlook
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx -y -p node@22 -p firebase-tools firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore,remoteconfig
